method: Profile (x radius, y along the axis): (0,0)-(0,40) on the axis, (0,40)-(10,40), (10,40)-(10,25), (10,25)-(10,15), (10,15)-(4,6), (4,6)-(0,0), revolved 360 degrees about the Y axis. V = 3000 pi = 9424.7780 mm3. Area: top disc 100 pi + cylinder 2 pi 10 25 + frustum pi (10+4) sqrt(81+36) + tip pi 4 sqrt(16+36) = 2451.3143 mm2.
